title: Renewal action log row
description: What was actually done for one scored subscriber (a playbook sent, a holdout kept, or nothing). The act step of score -> act -> outcome; joined to renewal outcomes by cli.outcomes to estimate lift against the holdout.

action_suggested.description: Policy output: a playbook name, holdout or no_action

holdout.description: True if the subscriber was deterministically held out of every playbook

would_have_sent.description: For holdout rows: the playbook the policy would have sent (empty otherwise or if none pays back)

executed_by.description: Who or what acted: the lifecycle tool, a named person (Ultra personal email), or 'none'

action_taken.description: What was actually sent (may differ: suppression lists, a person skipping the email)

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC time the action was logged
